intro: A generative language model written from first principles: character-level tokenization and an auto-regressive data pipeline today, then scaled dot-product attention, a Transformer block and a full training stack using Pytorch.
noteLead: Tensor shapes · attention math · failure modes - all on

runtime.label: Corpus
runtime.value: Any text input that is fairly long.

stages.title: Vocabulary & Tokenization
stages.summary: Character-level encoder over the raw corpus: unique token set, bijective maps, encode / decode with round-trip verification.
items: stoi (char -> int) and itos (int -> char) built from the sorted unique token set
Small vocabulary (~65 symbols), zero out-of-vocabulary tokens, long sequences as the trade-off

stages.title: Data Pipeline & Batching
stages.summary: Corpus to a torch.long tensor with a 90 / 10 split and a batch sampler over fixed context windows.
items: Encoded corpus read once into a 1D torch.long tensor
Train / validation split (90% / 10%) to catch overfitting early
get_batch(split, batch_size, block_size) -> x, y with shape (B, T)
Autoregressive pairs: x = data[i : i+T], y = data[i+1 : i+T+1] - T predictions per window

stages.title: Baseline Bigram Model
stages.summary: An attention-free lookup table that exercises the whole pipeline end to end and sets the loss baseline to beat.
items: Embedding + linear head: logits (B, T, V) against targets (B, T)
Flatten for cross-entropy: (B * T, V) vs (B * T)
Training loop: forward -> loss -> zero_grad -> backward -> step
Autoregressive generation loop sampling from the last position

stages.title: Self-Attention from Scratch
stages.summary: Scaled dot-product attention with a causal mask, first as one head, then as parallel heads concatenated through an output projection.

stages.title: The Transformer Block
stages.summary: Pre-LayerNorm blocks with residual connections, learned position embeddings, stacked L layers and a linear projection back to the vocabulary.

stages.title: Optimization & Training System
stages.summary: AdamW with a cosine learning-rate schedule and warmup, a no-grad validation loop, and checkpoint save / reload for long runs.

stages.title: Inference & Text Sampling
stages.summary: Greedy decoding, temperature scaling and top-k filtering, with a KV-cache so generation stays linear instead of quadratic.
